common_requirements: Use permitted development/example cases selected without held-out correctness.
Exercise the actual task prompt structure and native final-answer parser.
Preserve complete inputs and required modalities.
Freeze model, sampling, context, output budget, failure handling and full case manifest before a new run.
Give every fresh run a separate ID; retain every original generation and score.
Report failures and costs on the complete development set, without selecting successful examples.
A delivery pass does not establish biological correctness or authorize a full run by itself.

B08.priority: first small complete QA rerun only after its own checks
required_checks: Cloning-specific development/examples with actual prompt scaffolding and choice syntax.
Include relevant long inputs; verify source choices and native answer-tag extraction.
Record finite context/token counts and final-answer delivery, then review/freeze the complete 33-case configuration.
B08.existing_evidence: 33 historical input identities and tokenizer context checks pass; actual cloning development delivery is not demonstrated.

B07.priority: next QA priority after its own checks
required_checks: Sequence-QA development examples covering representative sequence lengths and source question types.
Actual native CoT prompt and answer-choice parser, preserving full sequences.
Record truncation, empty finals, parse rate and latency before freezing the full run.
Full-length GFP candidates under both native edit regimes and the native candidate parser.
Validate operation constraints and resulting complete sequence, not a ten-residue toy edit.
Freeze task-specific sampling and a documented per-slot randomness policy; do not silently reuse generic pilot settings or a shared seed.
Preserve all 100 candidate slots per regime and distinguish the trained fluorescence proxy from experimental validation.

P16.priority: defer large rerun pending a defined question and relevant checks
required_checks: Representative permitted sequence-plus-joint-class-description development prompts.
Normal final class delivery with the frozen native class range and extraction rule.
State what a rerun tests beyond formatting: the existing terminal-number diagnostic recovered only three additional correct labels.

P07.priority: last large rerun; strongest delivery requirement
required_checks: Publish all twelve actual-validation requests/responses, costs and failures.
Demonstrate reliable finite scalar delivery on representative permitted development inputs beyond trivial arithmetic.
Specify handling of residual failures and the local full-score completeness policy before committing to 27,217 cases.
Do not infer that twelve successes would guarantee complete delivery on the full task; current evidence has two failures.
Preserve the undefined full-score record and published parsed-case correlation.
Report the verified missing-output sensitivity bound and distinguish syntax errors, abstentions and qualified estimates.
Audit stability_score direction and meaning; any prompt clarification is a separately frozen future protocol.
Partition output-schema failures and report truncation crosscuts.
Distinguish unknown identifiers, numeric strings, wrong types, nonfinite values and identical versus conflicting duplicates.
Compare model and reference baselines on identical parsed-case IDs; show source and tie-grouped AP separately.
Freeze conservative normalization on output-only/development evidence before any application.
